notes: Any OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint with function calling: a self-hosted vLLM or SGLang, OpenRouter, or a campus service.
QWEN38_BASE_URL ends in /v1. QWEN38_MODEL is the name the server serves (vLLM --served-model-name; on OpenRouter, the provider's model id).
Claude Code talks to a loopback gateway that mlab starts; the upstream key never enters Claude Code's environment.
min_tokens keeps Qwen's reasoning from consuming a whole short reply; QWEN38_THINKING=false turns reasoning off.
Plain http:// is accepted for loopback and private-network hosts only (or with MLAB_ALLOW_HTTP=1).
